text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Federation of Industry (FOI) says European Union membership will benefit the industry. The FOI, a long standing supporter of Malta's bid to join the EU, told the political parties that "it does not make sense for Malta to stand alone in splendid isolation when its competitors are uniting under the aegis of different regional economic blocs."
- Ruling Nationalist Party accuses the Labour Party of telling lies on NP plans over VAT and bird hunting.
- Malta Drydocks workers celebrate 15th anniversary of the "Red China dock", a dock for supertankers built 15 years ago with China's financial and technical aid.
